note: Passenger needs, wants and satisfaction (docs/DESIGN_REVISION_4.md 6.2 and 6.3, D24 to D27, proposals of T67). Game hours and minutes are calendar time.

needs.note: Hours until a need falls due, the fixtures that meet it, visit minutes and spend share.

shop.note: Shop wants: threshold, visit minutes, spend share, favourite count and the shop categories.

satisfaction.note: Satisfaction terms per passenger, from a start score. Points per unit of each term. The ring keeps windowDays days.
